items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-06-15
items.q: King Collier had his brass band there playing. Got a good bass band too. Really nice fellas.

ctx.x: Yeah, they bought some fine colors. And every Sydney winter, you know what I mean? They had a band at the train, at the airplane. Oh yeah? Every Sydney winter. Yeah. Nice people. In London, we got there Sunday. We were in Liverpool one night at the hotels. The next morning we got the train. That evening we got in London that evening around about 2 o'clock. Oh man, they thought it was some kind of big convention. People had the train. The shade, just stand up on the shades of the airport. The shade went down. King…

Mm-hmm. But what about people in New York? Are they like that? People in New York is nice people too. Because, you see, but see Dick, I'll tell you one thing. Like a musician like us, we got, we had such a chance to give the best part to people.
